description: The DEFAULT ROUNDED clause of the OPTIONS paragraph (§2023:11.9.6) - a 2014 clause of the 2002 paragraph: with the paragraph gate at 2002, each 2014-only clause carries its own introduction arm (P10 Step 12). THE EDGE IS QUOTED from the edition texts (kb/Work PB3965): the 2002 paragraph is 'OPTIONS. [ arithmetic-clause ] [ entry-convention-clause ] .' (§2002:11.8.1), with no DEFAULT ROUNDED clause; the 2014 paragraph is 'OPTIONS. [ arithmetic-clause ] [ default-rounded-clause ] [ entry-convention-clause ] …' (§2014:11.9.1) and 'The DEFAULT ROUNDED clause specifies the type of rounding that applies when ROUNDED phrases of arithmetic statements' ... do not specify a rounding mode (§2014:11.9.5); §2014:E.3 item 27 (Rounding enhancements) records it, its a): 'the ability to specify a default rounding mode other than the preexisting nearest-away-from-zero for application in the ROUNDED clause of arithmetic statements'. 2023 keeps the clause (§2023:11.9.6.1).
vcr: 2014 introduction (§2023:11.9.6; a 2014 addition to the 2002 OPTIONS paragraph)
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. ODRP10AS.
OPTIONS.
    DEFAULT ROUNDED MODE IS NEAREST-EVEN.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 W PIC 9(3).
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    COMPUTE W ROUNDED = 5 / 2.
    DISPLAY W.
    STOP RUN.
